properties.name: A refused relation word that names an edge another tool draws is pointed at that tool, and the refusal's glosses are never cut mid-list
properties.source: Anthony, 2026-10-09, dev_reflow2 hub (work field log triage)
properties.statement:
When a relation argument (related_to, review_relations, a relation field) is refused with a word that matches an edge type's name by stem (governs to GOVERNED_BY, satisfies to SATISFIES, realizes to REALIZES), the refusal shall name the tool that draws that edge and its direction. The match is derived from the schema's edge names, not a hand-kept list. It names the tool and never draws the edge. And a refusal's list of allowed values with glosses shall not be cut mid-list: it says how many more there are and where to read them. Measured case: fact:a-relation-refusal-lists-the-review-words-cuts-their-glosses-and-never-names-the-tool-for-the-word-used-2026-10-09.

Anthony, 2026-10-09, kept this as intent when asked which of the field log's four ideas to keep (he kept all four).
